annotations.title: CI runners and why fixes wait

description: Return where this project's tests run and why a fix is slow to land (ADR 0033): the machines that send a runner heartbeat (hostname, platform, memory, swap, load, free disk, and per runner service its memory use, memory limit and out-of-memory kills), the GitHub runners seen (online | offline, busy, labels), repos, the latest jobs with their verdict (passed, running, queued, waiting_for_runner, runner_lost, queue_expired, cancelled, code_failure; waiting_for_runner, runner_lost and queue_expired are infra: the test machine stopped and the fix was not tested, which is not a code failure), and stats { queueP50s, queueP95s, durationP50s, durationP95s, passRate, infraFailures, codeFailures, byRunner, byWorkflow, slowSteps }, plus advice [{ id, severity (high | medium | low), title, detail, evidence, fix }] with the evidence for each rule. Optional projectId (default: the configured project; with an account-level key and no project, every project you can read), days (1-30, default 7) and refresh (true reads GitHub first instead of the last 10-minute sync, at most once a minute per project). permissions { jobs, runners } is ok | missing | unknown: jobs need Actions: read on GitHub, the runner list needs Administration: read (without it runners come from jobs only). Repo, workflow, job, step and runner names come from the repos. Returns { generatedAt, refreshedAt, window, permissions, hosts, runners, repos, jobs, stats, advice }. Read-only. When a fix's CI failed with an infra verdict, re-run the tests instead of changing code.

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to the server-configured project; omitted with an account-level key, every project you can read (`project_id` is accepted too.)

refresh.description: Read GitHub first instead of the last 10-minute sync (at most once a minute per project)

name: get_ci_overview

advice.description: Rule-based advice with evidence, most severe first

hosts.description: Machines that send a runner heartbeat

jobs.description: Latest jobs with their infra or code verdict
